summary: Twenty years of local experience is a strength, but a mailto only valuation request and no visible phone number appear to cost you valuations.

findings.problem: The free valuation call to action appears to be Click here linking to an email address, with a stray question mark, not a form.
findings.cost: Owners must open their email app to ask, and many will not.
findings.fix: An on page valuation form with name, address and phone.

findings.problem: No phone number appears on the homepage, and the only address shown appears to be a central London registered office while you cover South West London and Surrey.
findings.cost: Local owners cannot call you quickly or see you are nearby.
findings.fix: Visible phone, local office address and a coverage map.

findings.problem: Click here appears three times for three different actions, and the image gallery appears twice.
findings.cost: Vague links and repeated blocks make the page feel unpolished.
findings.fix: Specific button labels and a clean layout.

findings.problem: The award banner and accreditation logos appear to have no detail, and no reviews or sales figures appear.
findings.cost: Without proof, owners compare you to agents who show it.
findings.fix: Review scores, sales results and short explanations of memberships.
